description: This PHP source file defines the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It manages leave entitlement periods, particularly handling changes in leave period dates by updating related database records via Doctrine ORM queries. The class extends BaseDao, incorporating date handling traits, and provides the handleLeavePeriodChange method that adjusts entitlement date ranges upon period modifications.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao
classes.description: A DAO class that handles leave entitlement period updates, specifically managing changes using a FIFO strategy within the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Updates the leave entitlement periods when the leave period dates are changed, adjusting current and future entitlements using database queries and date manipulations.
